build_melspectrogram_wrapper: build a MelSpectrogramWrapper module to compute log-scaled mel spectrograms from audio waveforms with configurable FFT parameters
create_melspectrogram_l1_loss: create a MelSpectrogramL1Loss module to compute L1 loss between two audio signals in the mel spectrogram domain
build_multiscale_mel_loss: build a MultiScaleMelSpectrogramLoss module to compute multi-scale L1 and L2 spectrogram losses across multiple FFT resolutions
test_melspectrogram_wrapper_forward: test the MelSpectrogramWrapper forward pass by computing mel spectrograms from a batch of audio tensors
review_multiscale_loss_alphas: review the MultiScaleMelSpectrogramLoss alphas weighting scheme to understand how scale coefficients are computed
